title: Subnet News — August 14, 2026
summary: Bittensor's tape narrowed again while Leadpoet extended its move, but the stronger fundamental signals came from fresh software and operating changes: Subtensor's v446 release branch merged, NIOME set a v3 launch date, Ditto altered its burn rollout, Affine's evaluator stalled, and several public subnet repositories shipped material fixes.

highlights.headline: Breadth contracts to 32% while Leadpoet extends its separation
highlights.summary: At the 10:00 AM ET cutoff, 41 of 128 subnet markets were positive and 87 were negative, with roughly 177,642 TAO of displayed 24-hour volume. Leadpoet gained 42.7%, TAO Private Network rose 23.6%, and MVTRX added 13.2%; SN70 fell 12.2%, cascade lost 11.3%, and ConnitoAI declined 8.9%. SubnetRadar's independently calculated breadth was 31%, with the small difference attributable to snapshot timing and methodology.

highlights.headline: Fast wallet rotation leaves engy with two-way flow rather than a clean signal
highlights.summary: SubnetRadar recorded repeated profitable-wallet buys and sells in engy during the window, including a 600 TAO whale stake and later clusters moving in both directions. The cutoff screener still showed engy up 4.1% over 24 hours but about 137 TAO of estimated one-hour reserve outflow. Leadpoet showed about 176 TAO of estimated one-hour inflow, while iota and Bitcast showed roughly 231 and 160 TAO of outflow. Provider labels describe wallet history, not motive or coordination.

updates.headline: NanoExpand adds year-specific capacity as the validator drops older gates
updates.summary: ChronoLLM added a tested NanoExpand architecture that can insert optional residual MLP blocks after selected decoder layers, giving later cutoff years dedicated capacity while preserving earlier knowledge. A separate merge removed ChronoGPT support and the SVD baseline gate and documented a six-stage evaluation pipeline from anti-copy checks through reward distribution. The validator image was then updated to the new build.

updates.headline: Validator preserves a minimum weight for every live miner
updates.summary: Lium's validator now gives every live executor omitted by u16 conversion a one-unit weight floor, funded only from burn entries so earning miners are not diluted. A separate installer hardening merge rejects kernels without ID-mapped overlay mounts and adds Docker 29.5 time-namespace handling. These are deployed-code merges; their effect on miner participation was not yet observable at cutoff.

updates.headline: NIOME schedules v3 for August 15 with a revised emission system
updates.summary: The team moved its earlier 'this week' guidance to a concrete August 15 mainnet target. The accompanying design rewards the top five miners and adds coldkey and IP checks intended to prevent one operator from occupying multiple rewarded slots. This is a scheduled software release, not an alpha-token unlock.

updates.headline: NOVA retries failed inference shards and guards score alignment
updates.summary: NOVA merged a substantial inference-path repair that retries failed molecular shards and changes result assembly to use each UID's validated submission structure. Peer-average replacement now drops mismatched score positions with an explicit warning instead of indexing stale rows. The fix targets validator reliability; no performance claim was independently measured.

updates.headline: Marketplace adds an atomic storage-plan change
updates.summary: Hippius added a single marketplace call that moves an active storage subscription between plans without the entitlement gap, resubscribe cooldown, or double billing created by cancel-and-repurchase. The implementation nets refunds against charges, preserves referral attribution, and includes thirteen runtime integration tests. This code landed after Hippius Drive's previously covered launch and is a separate product-layer change.

updates.headline: Miner dashboard exposes warm-start rotation history
updates.summary: Cascade's public repository added the scheduled warm-start checkpoint, its origin round, rotation order, and a last-ten-round history table to the miner dashboard, then corrected a live-heat label. The changes make the current training rotation easier for miners to audit; they do not establish a new model-quality result.

updates.headline: Ditto activates burn emissions without LongMemEval
updates.summary: Ditto released burn emissions while holding back LongMemEval, a genuine change from yesterday's v9 repair phase. Team messages said top agents were tied around 0.997, so retests are being used to separate scores; embedding traffic moved to Perplexity after reported 429 failures, while a Rizzo failure and validator stalls remained under repair at cutoff.

updates.headline: Evaluation stalls for more than five hours amid connector faults
updates.summary: Affine's challenger connector failures blocked model validation for more than five hours, a new operational failure after yesterday's policy discussion. Participants also reported duplicate or exploit-based models occupying top ranks and disputed queue ordering. These fairness claims remain developing, but the infrastructure outage was broadly reported in the official channel.

ecosystem.headline: Subtensor merges the v446 release branch
ecosystem.summary: The merged release repairs historical alpha issuance and burn accounting, changes the conviction-ownership quorum denominator to eligible alpha, adds Current, Previous and Auto Liquid Alpha consensus modes, retains failed timelock reveals as auditable terminal states, and fixes Finney GRANDPA warp-sync set-ID handling. The merge is strong release evidence, but it is not proof that Finney enacted spec 446 before the cutoff.

ecosystem.headline: Conviction remains mostly perpetual while Bitcast records a real lock reduction
ecosystem.summary: SubnetRadar showed 29.23 million alpha locked across 123 subnets, 88% in perpetual mode, with network conviction up 0.2% over 24 hours. Fresh events included two SN88 locks totaling about 17.4k alpha, a 15.0k-alpha SN93 lock followed by a separate 4.4k-alpha on-chain reduction, and a 10-alpha OxMarkets flip to perpetual. No event supplied a future date and amount that qualifies for Unlock Watch; decaying positions release continuously rather than as guaranteed one-day cliffs.

ecosystem.headline: Full-burn count eases to 43 as gm captures the largest hourly emission shift
ecosystem.summary: SubnetRadar counted 43 of 128 reporting subnets at or above 90% miner burn, down from 45 in yesterday's coverage. The cutoff screener showed gm's emission share rising about 0.30 percentage points in one hour to 1.68%, while Chutes remained the largest share at 12.10%. Targon's first-halving watch advanced to 57% of 10.5 million alpha with an estimated 555 days remaining. No verified halving, registration, deregistration, or slot replacement occurred inside the window.
